title: Café Reel With Matching Captions
tests: Checks exact caption wording, photo-caption alignment and readability in a short finished reel.

exact_text.read_as: Not visible in the supplied output frames.

faults.what: The final interior shot uses the pastry photo as its blurred top and bottom background, creating conspicuously mismatched image bands.
Large centered captions obscure important photo details, particularly the latte art, although the words themselves are clearly legible.

judge.summary: The 10.1-second vertical reel has clear captions in the sampled shots, but the final shot has mismatched background bands and the pastry caption cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: One vertical reel runs for approximately 10 seconds and includes all five supplied café photos in attachment order.
must_haves.why: A single 10.1-second vertical output is shown, with storefront, latte, barista, and interior appearing in that order; no sampled frame establishes a separate pastry segment between latte and barista.

must_haves.item: Each specified caption appears exactly, paired with its corresponding photo.
must_haves.why: Four captions appear exactly on the appropriate subjects, but 'Something sweet' is not visible in the supplied samples; it could appear in an unsampled interval.

must_haves.item: Captions remain visible long enough to read and are not clipped by the frame edges.
must_haves.why: The visible captions have generous edge clearance and are easy to read, but isolated frames do not establish their display durations.

must_haves.item: Caption contrast and placement keep the words legible over every photo.
must_haves.why: All four visible captions are large, high-contrast, and legible, generally using dark backing, but the pastry caption is not available for inspection.

must_haves.item: Mellow music is audible beneath the photo sequence.
must_haves.why: The audio report establishes a non-silent soundtrack without clear speech, but does not distinguish music from ambience or establish a mellow mood.
